abilities.name: Arch-Deceiver
abilities.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 3" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Puckish Misdirection
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, halve the target’s Move characteristic for the rest of the turn.
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 9" of this unit to be the target.

abilities.name: Discord and Confusion
abilities.effect:
Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit until the start of your next turn.
In addition, until the start of your next turn, roll a dice each time this unit is targeted by an ability that is not an **^^Attack^^** ability. On a 4+, another eligible unit must be targeted by that ability instead of this unit. If it is not possible to target another unit, that ability has no effect.
